findings.detail: E07 source count appears to include non-position or out-of-scope schedule rows, while the 2025 investment schedule contains 23 extractable private holdings and ties to the 184.466 million total.

rationale: False alarm. This is a Class 3 aggregate count flag, but the raw current-period investment schedule localizes cleanly: table 22 has 16 loan position rows before its subtotal, and table 23 has 7 private equity/preferred position rows before Total Investments, matching the 23 output rows. The schedule total fair value is 184.466 million, equal to the extracted quarter fair value in the bundle; the larger source=116 count is therefore an overbroad rule-scope/count anchor rather than evidence of missing holdings.
